title: Uses of Domestic Animals
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use the animals the children see at home. A walk to see the school's or a neighbour's animals works better than pictures.

skills.key_step: The child names the domestic animals kept in the community (cattle, goats, sheep, donkeys, camels, pigs, rabbits, chickens, ducks, turkeys, bees, dogs, cats) and groups them (livestock, poultry, pets, bees).

floor.prerequisite: Knows a domestic animal is kept by people.
floor.question: Who looks after a domestic animal?

representations: a visit to the school or a neighbour's animals
steps: Put it in its group: livestock, poultry, pet or bees.

board.do: Draw three boxes: livestock, poultry, pets.
Write duck with chickens and turkeys.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a domestic animal?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who feeds, houses and looks after each animal.

listen_for: None, birds are not domestic animals
misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a domestic animal kept for eggs?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which birds the community keeps at home.
Ask which animals have feathers and lay eggs.

listen_for: No, we do not eat it
misconceptions.ask: Is a dog a domestic animal?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who feeds and shelters the dog. Domestic means kept and cared for by people.

checks.question: Name two kinds of poultry.
checks.answer: any two of chicken, duck, turkey, goose

checks.question: Is a giraffe a domestic animal?

skills.key_step: The child matches each domestic animal to what it gives (milk, meat, eggs, wool, hides, honey, manure) and does (carrying, ploughing, guarding, catching rats), and says one animal can have several uses.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the domestic animals in the community.
floor.question: Name a domestic animal.

representations: a matching chart: animal and uses
products: an egg, a bottle of milk, honey
pictures of a donkey cart and an ox plough
contexts: a cow giving milk and manure

board.do: Draw a cow in the middle with three arrows.
Ask what to write at each arrow.
Wait for milk, meat, manure or ploughing.
Write all the uses on the arrows.

misconceptions.repair: Show wool, milk, eggs and honey and ask where each comes from.

listen_for: None, an animal gives only one thing
misconceptions.ask: Which animal gives us milk, meat and hides?
misconceptions.repair: Make a list of everything one cow gives the family.

misconceptions.ask: Which animal is used to carry loads?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which animals in the village pull carts and which do not.

listen_for: None, it is only a pet
misconceptions.ask: What use is a cat on a farm?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what eats the maize in a store at night, and what chases it away.

checks.question: Give two uses of a cow.
checks.answer: any two of milk, meat, hides, manure, ploughing
